start.text: North of the Ridge Light the old Keepers' road climbs onto Thornwold's spine and goes along it: a back of grey stone and silvered heather a few strides wide, falling away into the fog on both sides.

Behind you the Ridge Light is a warm smudge, low over the shoulder of the ridge. Ahead, a long way off at the end of the spine, there is a smudge of red, and on the wind, very faint, the smell of a charcoal clamp.
